newsitem.title: MALTA: Mid-Med Life Assurance records loss.
newsitem.headline: Mid-Med Life Assurance records loss.

text.p: Mid-Med Life Assurance, a subsidiary of Malta's Mid-Med Bank, made a loss of 240,704 Maltese pounds ($625,830) in the 17 months since it was set up to end-December 1996
But company chairman Philip Sciberras said on Wednesday that was "well in line with business plan projections" and accounted for planned start-up costs and initial overseas consultancy work.
Sciberras said very encouraging results in premium income and other areas augured well for the future.
"In 1997, Mid-Med Life expects to accelerate development and achieve improved results, particularly through the implementation of further information technology systems and new products.
"Efficiency and the generation of new business with higher premiums from both individual and group business lines should also prove beneficial to the company," Sciberras said.
The company had developed a strong relationship with lead reinsurers, Cologne Re of Germany, he said. Cologne Re had expressed satisfaction with the success achieved so far.
